question: Which constructors had the top 3 combined points from their best driver and team, and in which years did they achieve them?
sql:
WITH driver_points AS (
    SELECT ra.year, r.constructor_id, c.name as constructor_name, MAX(r.points) as best_driver_points
    FROM results r
    JOIN constructors c ON r.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
    JOIN races ra ON r.race_id = ra.race_id
    GROUP BY ra.year, r.constructor_id, c.name
),
team_points AS (
    SELECT ra.year, rs.constructor_id, c.name as constructor_name, SUM(rs.points) as total_constructor_points
    FROM constructor_standings rs
    JOIN constructors c ON rs.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
    JOIN races ra ON rs.race_id = ra.race_id
    GROUP BY ra.year, rs.constructor_id, c.name
),
combined AS (
    SELECT dp.year, dp.constructor_id, dp.constructor_name, dp.best_driver_points, tp.total_constructor_points,
           dp.best_driver_points + tp.total_constructor_points as combined_points
    FROM driver_points dp
    JOIN team_points tp ON dp.year = tp.year AND dp.constructor_id = tp.constructor_id
),
max_combined AS (
    SELECT constructor_id, constructor_name, MAX(combined_points) as max_combined_points
    FROM combined
    GROUP BY constructor_id, constructor_name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT constructor_id, constructor_name, max_combined_points,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY max_combined_points DESC) as rank
    FROM max_combined
)
SELECT r.constructor_name, r.max_combined_points, c.year
FROM combined c
JOIN ranked r ON c.constructor_id = r.constructor_id
WHERE r.rank <= 3 AND c.combined_points = r.max_combined_points
ORDER BY r.rank, c.year
